headline: Central Bank of Egypt Raises Interest Rates by One Percentage Point
summary: The Central Bank of Egypt raised its interest rates by one percentage point in a pre-emptive move to sustain disinflation and ensure the 2027 inflation target is met.
why: Central banks adjust benchmark policy rates to manage domestic inflation, influence credit conditions, and stabilize their national currency.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: The central bank's rate hike directly affects domestic monetary policy and borrowing costs within Egypt.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Interest rate increases raise borrowing costs, which central banks use to cool domestic economic demand and rein in inflation.
